## Freestar - Senior Software Engineer – Javascript, Ad Tech

🔗 [Apply](https://boards.greenhouse.io/freestar/jobs/8771013002)

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Senior Software Engineer owning Prebid.js, Prebid Server, and header bidding systems. Improving ad monetization and web performance for Freestar’s publisher websites at scale.
Senior Software Engineer optimizing Prebid header bidding for Freestar’s publisher monetization platform
- Tech stack: BigQuery, Cloud, Google Cloud Platform, JavaScript, TypeScript
- Write and ship production code daily as a senior hands-on developer
- Review peers' pull requests and partner with engineers to ensure codebase quality
- Serve as subject-matter expert for Prebid.js and Prebid Server
- Advise on wrapper architecture, bid adapters, identity, consent, floors, and analytics modules
- Track Prebid releases, OpenRTB specification changes, and emerging header-bidding standards
- Translate ecosystem developments into platform recommendations and upgrades
- Own the header bidding wrapper end to end, including architecture, release cycle, feature integration, and design decisions
- Work daily with Google Ad Manager, GPT, and the IMA SDK
- Deep, hands-on expertise with Prebid.js — wrapper configuration, bid adapters, modules (identity, consent, floors, analytics)
- In depth knowledge of the auction lifecycle
- Experience with Prebid Server — stored requests, server-side adapter configuration, s2s routing, and more
- Strong working knowledge of Google Ad Manager, including GPT, line item architecture, key-value targeting, unified pricing rules, dynamic allocation, and more
- 4+ years of experience in JavaScript development, with substantial TypeScript experience
- Experience with Google Cloud Platform (e.g., GKE, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, BigQuery) for deploying and operating high-throughput services
- Broad ad tech fluency: OpenRTB, SSP/DSP integrations, identity solutions and EIDs, consent frameworks (TCF/GPP), Amazon TAM/APS, video (IMA SDK/VAST)
- Strong experience with asynchronous programming and understanding of client-server architecture

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior Software Engineer owning Prebid.js, Prebid Server, and header bidding systems. Improving ad monetization and web performance for Freestar’s publisher websites at scale.
Senior Software Engineer optimizing Prebid header bidding for Freestar’s publisher monetization platform
Role description:
• Write and ship production code daily as a senior hands-on developer
• Review peers' pull requests and partner with engineers to ensure codebase quality
• Serve as subject-matter expert for Prebid.js and Prebid Server
• Advise on wrapper architecture, bid adapters, identity, consent, floors, and analytics modules
• Track Prebid releases, OpenRTB specification changes, and emerging header-bidding standards
• Translate ecosystem developments into platform recommendations and upgrades
• Own the header bidding wrapper end to end, including architecture, release cycle, feature integration, and design decisions
• Work daily with Google Ad Manager, GPT, and the IMA SDK
• Maintain high-quality JavaScript and TypeScript client-side scripts running across thousands of publisher sites
• Measure and protect Core Web Vitals, including INP, LCP, and CLS, plus memory usage, execution time, and network overhead
• Own deployed solutions, maintain reliability, and address critical issues to preserve system stability and performance
Role requirements:
• Deep, hands-on expertise with Prebid.js — wrapper configuration, bid adapters, modules (identity, consent, floors, analytics)
• In depth knowledge of the auction lifecycle
• Experience with Prebid Server — stored requests, server-side adapter configuration, s2s routing, and more
• Strong working knowledge of Google Ad Manager, including GPT, line item architecture, key-value targeting, unified pricing rules, dynamic allocation, and more
• 4+ years of experience in JavaScript development, with substantial TypeScript experience
• Experience with Google Cloud Platform (e.g., GKE, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, BigQuery) for deploying and operating high-throughput services
• Broad ad tech fluency: OpenRTB, SSP/DSP integrations, identity solutions and EIDs, consent frameworks (TCF/GPP), Amazon TAM/APS, video (IMA SDK/VAST)
• Strong experience with asynchronous programming and understanding of client-server architecture
• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a distributed team environment
• Excellent technical documentation and communication skills
• Ability to be creative and contribute based on your merit
• This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship
Tech stack:
BigQuery, Cloud, Google Cloud Platform, JavaScript, TypeScript
